dina: Following up on the DR postmortem  I created a compact action list (5 items). Need owners, short acceptance criteria, and planned test windows.
omar: I can own the routing rollback/playbook improvements. Deliverable: audited routes + a small safe flip script.
lucy: I'll handle backups & retention fixes. Planning a staged restore in the sandbox env on Friday.
jj: I'll run the dry-run coordination and capture timings. Propose Tue 14:00 PT for a 2h window.
odar: (typo) -- ignore
omar: Routing test scope: 1) zone blackout (simulated), 2) region failover, 3) gradual peering slowdown. Script has `--measure-only` and `--execute`.
lucy: Minimal restore checklist I'll paste here:
```
- verify snapshot exists: `gcloud compute snapshots list --filter="labels.role=db && labels.env=prod" --limit=1`
- provision dr-test cluster: `terraform apply -var=dr_test=true`
- restore DB: `pg_restore --dbname=dr_test latest.dump`
- smoke: `curl -fsS http://dr-test.app/healthz`
- sample verify: `python tools/sample_check.py --n=5`
```
jj: I'll publish the run-of-show and invite EU on-call. Also will ensure ops-bot posts artifacts to the tracker after tests.
dina: Owners + quick deadlines:
- routing audit + flip script -> omar -> due 2172600000
- backups retention + runbook -> lucy -> due 2172450000
- dry-run coordination + invites -> jj -> due 2172350000
- IAM/service-account precheck -> lucy -> due 2172320000
- post-dry-run retro -> all -> due 2172800000
omar: Add cache rehydration check: sample 12 keys, run 10min post-flip, fail if miss rate > 8%. Will emit CSV and small graph.
lucy: Found one short retention (14 days) for backup bucket redwood-prod-snapshots. I'll open a ticket to extend to 90 days and add weekly fulls + daily incrementals.
jj: ops-bot: please ensure that any test artifacts are tagged with `incident:DR-2026` and that the incident card gets the summary.
ops-bot: acknowledged: will post artifacts and summary to the incident tracker automatically when tests finish.
dina: Two operational guardrails to add to the runbook: 1) explicit abort thresholds (DB checksum mismatch >0 or error-rate > 25%); 2) owner escalation path.
omar: I'll attach the first sandbox run results and a short README after I run the sim tomorrow.
lucy: I'll open the retention ticket tonight and draft the runbook PR.
jj: I'll lock the calendar slot and send invites after quick availability check with EU on-call.
dina: Thanks team  goal is a repeatable playbook, measurable acceptance, and clear owners. I'll create the action-tracker card now and ping owners there. :thumbsup:
